overview.en: Joe and Lara Travers are a couple on vacation, but it isn’t what it seems. They’re undercover, although we’re unsure to what degree, all we know is they’re traveling with knives and guns and aren’t your average couple, and can’t seem to escape this Cessna 206 aircraft they’re paranoid may be after them.

Akshay plays a gangster and Kriti a journalist. The twist in the tale occurs when the two characters meet and discover their common passion for cinema, which brings along action, drama and humor, because while the gangster is a wannabe actor, the journalist aspires to be a director.

This movie is about the life of a middle class, widowed father, Shrikant that takes an unexpected turn when his seven year old Son, Mandar collapses and is referred to Jansanjeevani Hospital for a detailed diagnosis. Things take a trun when Mandar starts talking to a mysterious figure he claims to be staying in the abandoned part of the hospital.
Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson stars in this series that explores the whirlwind life of a group of current and former football players in Miami.

title.de: Band of Brothers - Wir waren wie Brüder

overview.de: Diese bahnbrechende zehnteilige HBO-Miniserie erzählt die bemerkenswerten Leistungen einer Elitetruppe von US-Fallschirmjägern im Zweiten Weltkrieg.
overview.en: The story of Easy Company, 506th Regiment of the 101st Airborne Division, U.S. Army.

overview.de: In Banshee, PA, trennt die Polizei und die Ganoven nur ein schmaler Grat ... besonders, weil der designierte Sheriff in Wahrheit ein Meisterdieb ist. Staffel 1 dieser spannenden Action-Serie von Alan Ball, dem Schöpfer von „True Blood", zeichnet die Irrwege von Lucas Hood (Antony Starr) nach, einem Ex-Sträfling auf Bewährung, der dank einer bizarren Schicksalsfügung die Identität des neuen Sher...
overview.en: A recently paroled crook assumes the identity of a small town's new sheriff in this Cinemax action series from Alan Ball ('True Blood').
During World War II, hardened Russian soldiers meet a moral crossroads when they encounter a group of young children during their mission.

Biswa Kalyan Rath, is a comedian who used to be angry at the world. Now he is disappointed. In this special, shot in London because London is on Earth and he is a human of Earth, he explores various themes on how the world is an irritating place. On second thought he’s still angry but that’s none of your business unless you are also angry, in which case please watch. Enjoy. Or don’t. Any problem?
An adaptation of the classic novel. Carrie, a girl with telekinetic powers, teaches her classmates a deadly lesson when they humiliate her at prom.
Big wave surfers chase the majesty of powerful storms and the huge, crystal waves they create as the 2016 El Nino season pours in full effect.

title.de: Das Lager - Wir gingen durch die Hölle

overview.en: Una vez terminada la Segunda Guerra Mundial, un grupo de prisioneros de guerra alemanes terminan en un campo de concentración soviético.

title.de: Death Wish 2 - Der Mann ohne Gnade

overview.en: A father moves his daughter across the country for a fresh start. When she is brutally murdered by a gang, her father vows to avenge her.

A Coast Guard Admiral (Dennis Quaid) and a handbag designer (Rene Russo) fall in love and marry, much to the dismay of her 10 and his 8 children. As the children plot to separate their parents, they come to realize that what matters most is family!

Alex Lippi breaks up couples for a living, for a fee he can make any woman fall in love with him and decide to leave her terrible partner. His services are engaged by a crime boss whose estranged daughter is marrying a charming, English, billionaire philanthropist. It's difficult for Alex and his team to find a fault with her fiance that they can exploit, but they need the money so with only ten days till the wedding they travel to Mont.

This is the story of East and West Germany from both sides of the wall, told through the exploits of one man. The series has received critical acclaim and was the first German-language series to be broadcast on US TV. (German with English Subtitles).
EPIC TAILS tells the story of super smart mouse Pattie and her feline friend Sam, as they embark upon an exciting adventure of paw-some proportions through Ancient Greece.

Jagteshwar (Tarsem Jassar), a librarian, has obsessive - compulsive personality disorder (OCPD), which people around him have accepted both at work and home. Ideologies clash and things change when Amberdeep (Wamiqa Gabbi), a high-spirited girl in nature and Jagteshwar shares a roof.

overview.de: Ein sittsamer Geschäftsmann trifft in einem New Yorker Lokal auf eine freigeistige Frau. Ihr Angebot, ihn in sein Büro zu fahren, führt zu einem Rendezvous in einem Motel und ist der Startschuss für einen impulsiven Roadtrip quer durch die USA, auf dem beide ihre verborgenen Seiten entdecken.
overview.en: A conservative businessman accepts a ride from a free-spirited woman, sparking an outrageous journey that swings from reckless fun to real danger.

overview.de: Das Kriegsgefangenen-Lager Stalag Luft III im Deutschland des Jahres 1944 scheint absolut ausbruchsicher. Nicht für Major Bartlett (Richard Attenborough) und seine Männer. Diese verschworene Gemeinschaft alliierter Fliegeroffiziere wagt den verzweifelten Fluchtversuch – und sprengt die Ketten. Hollywood Regisseur John Sturges verfilmte mit einem Star-Aufgebot (Steve McQueen, James Garner, Charles Bronson, James Coburn) diese authentische Geschichte einer dramatischen Flucht von 76 Gefangenen, die nur ein Ziel vor Augen hatten: Die Freiheit.
overview.en: A group of Allied POWs engineer a bold escape from a Nazi camp in World War II.

title.de: Hans Zimmer & Friends: Diamond in the Desert
title.en: Hans Zimmer & Friends: Diamond in the Desert

overview.en: An extraordinary live performance of Hans Zimmer's most beloved and renowned movie soundtracks, including music from Dune, Gladiator, Interstellar, and The Lion King. Featuring conversations with creative collaborators Billie Eilish, Christopher Nolan, Denis Villeneuve, Finneas, Jerry Bruckheimer, Pharrell Williams, Timothée Chalamet, Zendaya, and more.

overview.de: Nach dem Tod ihrer psychisch kranken Mutter erkennt eine Frau mit ihrer Familie ihre düstere Abstammung in diesem „rohen Horror-Meisterwerk" (Empire).
overview.en: After their grandmother passes away, a family tries to outrun the sinister fate they've inherited.

overview.de: Six-episode series. The Ingebrigtsen brothers are back in a dramatic season. Without a coach, the brothers must support each other while their father Gjert is under investigation. Jakob is expecting a child and faces injury issues. Henrik juggles running and family challenges, while Filip is unsure of the future as he is haunted by injuries.
overview.en: Six-episode series. The Ingebrigtsen brothers are back in a dramatic season. Without a coach, the brothers must support each other while their father Gjert is under investigation. Jakob is expecting a child and faces injury issues. Henrik juggles running and family challenges, while Filip is unsure of the future as he is haunted by injuries.

In 1945 the Nazis flew to the Dark Side of the Moon, where they've been preparing for their grand return. The year is 2018, and the Americans return to the Moon in search for powerful energy source. They end up landing too close to the secret Nazi fortress, and although the big Nazi weapon is not yet ready to be deployed the Nazi war machines take a pre-emptive move against threat from Earth.

Jaspreet Singh takes on "mundane" topics like the ever-growing motivation market, godmen, serious parenting to the "tough" bouncers like his door bell, the salad he made and the absurdity of the teenage. His first comedy special is a perfect amalgamation of his niche observations, signature laid back attitude with quick paced punchlines.

overview.de: Baby John und seine Familie präsentieren klassische Kinderlieder und eingängige neue Lieder zum Mitsingen, mit denen Vorschulkinder alles über die Welt lernen können.
overview.en: In this musical preschool series, a family sings songs as they learn, play and explore the world together.

overview.de: In diesem albtraumhaften Thriller gerät eine ahnungslose Teenagergruppe in die Falle, als sie sich mit einer einsamen Frau anfreundet, deren Gastfreundschaft zur Besessenheit wird.
overview.en: A group of teens run afoul of a deranged woman (Octavia Spencer) who lets them party in her basement.

Nobody knows what makes the mysterious Monica the most desired bar dancer in the city with a line of lovers running as far as Haji Ali. Only Monica knows the secret of her wild success but she also knows that the secret can kill her. When Monica goes missing her many lovers come out crawling and what ensues is chaos.

A Director calls for an audition and makes a movie out of it by creating conflicts between the artists who attend the audition. First of its kind realistic commercial film in Kannada that has multiple characters and touches upon current social conflicts in a humorous and satirical way

title.de: Mein Freund Smitty - Ein tierisches Abenteuer

overview.en: While spending the summer at his grandfather's farm, a boy learns about the importance of friendship, family and responsibility with the help of a lovable rescue dog.
A sexy divorcée falls for an over-the-hill cowboy who is struggling to maintain his romantically independent lifestyle in early-sixties Nevada.

title.de: Nishant Tanwar : Dilli Se Hoon B*@!%D
title.en: Nishant Tanwar : Dilli Se Hoon B*@!%D

overview.en: Delhi boy Nishant Tanwar's latest stand-up special "Dilli Se Hoon B*@!&#%D" is a code for all Delhiites to abide by. Known as bhai by his fans, Nishant shares hilarious life experiences, the background he comes from, his dad, his friends.

title.de: Nur dir zuliebe - Gori Tere Pyaar Mein

overview.en: Sriram is concerned only with spending money, until he meets Dia, a principled activist. Now he's determined to prove himself worthy of her affection.
After an odd accident, Joana hides the incident from her partner until a video exposes the truth, leading her into the family life of her assailant.

overview.de: Das Hitler-Attentat vom 20. Juli 1944 als Thriller: Als Oberst Graf von Stauffenberg legt Tom Cruise eine Bombe, die Hitler töten soll. Von "X-Men"-Regisseur Bryan Singer. - Deutschland 1944: Überzeugt, dass Hitler das Land ins Verderben stürzt, schließt sich Oberst Graf von Stauffenberg (Tom Cruise) einer Widerstandsgruppe an. Die Verschwörer planen ein Attentat auf Hitler in der Wolfschanze. Am 20. Juli lässt Stauffenberg die Bombe hochgehen. Aber bald ist klar: Der Tyrann hat überlebt. Und wird mit den Verschwörern gnadenlos abrechnen.
overview.en: As the Nazi regime's tyranny grows, a German colonel's loyalty is tested, pushing him to orchestrate a violent coup with his fellow officers.
In a small town, Robert Perkins builds an army of 14 people brainwashed through cult-like methods to protect him from his parents' killers.

A white employer swapping identities with his Black employee to experience each other’s lives and whatever blessings and burdens they bring with. Wearing each other’s skins so to speak, fully immerses them into each other’s worlds and gives each one of them a unique and insightful perspective of what really matters and what it takes to meet each other half way.
After moving to a new home, the ghastly ghosts return to battle the Freeling family once more for the soul of a young clairvoyant.

overview.de: Tom Cruise ist ein junger Autoverkäufer, dessen Leben sich für immer ändert, als er entdeckt, dass er einen autistischen älteren Bruder mit außergewöhnlichen Gaben hat (Dustin Hoffman, der einen Oscar für den besten Hauptdarsteller gewonnen hat).
overview.en: Dustin Hoffman and Tom Cruise star in this Oscar-winner about a wheeler-dealer (Cruise) who is shocked to discover that his late father's estate is going to an autistic brother he never knew he had (Hoffman). When Cruise kidnaps his brother from an institution to bargain for his share of the estate, they begin an eye-opening road trip in this engrossing and acclaimed film.

title.de: Real Detective - Fälle, die man nie vergisst

overview.en: Crimes from across the UK are unpacked and retold in intimate detail through police files, CCTV footage and accounts from those who helped solve them.
Little ones will love learning and having all kinds of fun, from singing and dancing to using their imagination with these friendly, smart sharks!

title.de: Shrek 2 - Der tollkühne Held kehrt zurück

overview.de: SHREK 2, die beste Komödie aller Zeiten, von Kritikern gefeiert als noch besser als seine Oscar®-gekrönten Vorgänger! USA Today verkündet: "Es gibt so viele Witze und Scherze, nicht einmal ein blähbäuchiger Oger könnte sie alle auf einmal verdauen!"
overview.en: Shrek, Fiona and Donkey visit Fiona's royal parents in the Kingdom of Far Far Away, where they're not as welcomed as they'd thought they'd be.

overview.de: „Silence“ erzählt eine packende Geschichte von Schuld, Verrat und Erlösung, als Bode mit dem Tod seines Freundes Dapo konfrontiert wird und sich mit Missbrauch, Untreue und dem empfindlichen Gleichgewicht zwischen Loyalität und dem Schutz des Wohls eines jungen Mädchens auseinandersetzt.
overview.en: 'Silence' unfolds a gripping story of guilt, betrayal, and redemption as Bode confronts his friend Dapo's death, navigating abuse, infidelity, and the delicate balance between loyalty and protecting a young girl's welfare.

The action-packed adventure reveals the origins of the iconic G.I. JOE hero, SNAKE EYES. To defeat the terrorist group COBRA, SNAKE EYES becomes the ultimate warrior, but when his past is revealed, he risks everything he has been fighting for.
A rookie cop is recruited by a special unit of human and inhuman officers, infamous for their reckless methods.

Splash and Bubbles follows the adventures of Splash, a yellow fusilier fish who has migrated all over the oceans before settling down with his family in Reeftown, where he befriends three inquisitive fellow sea creatures. Until Splash came along, Bubbles, Dunk, Ripple and most of the other Reeftown residents had no idea what lay beyond the cozy confines of their coral walls.
Rivals turned friends find their bromance tested when they battle it out to win not only a grueling school competition, but also the same girl's heart.

In the stylish animated series The Batman, one of the most complex and intriguing characters in comic book history swoops into action-packed adventures. In Gotham, amongst the shadows, a young Batman finds his way as a protector, defender and Caped Crusader, while maintaining his public persona as billionaire bachelor Bruce Wayne.

overview.de: Anna Arnardóttir, eine der führenden Vulkanologinnen Islands, sieht sich mit zwei Katastrophen konfrontiert: einem Vulkanausbruch, der die Sicherheit der Einwohner der Hauptstadt bedroht, und einer Affäre, die ihre Ehe zerstören könnte.
overview.en: Volcanologist Anna must set out on a desperate quest to save her family and the citizens of the capital city from devastating eruptions, earthquakes and fallout from the natural disaster.

overview.de: 1912. Four young revolutionaries, Rash Behari Bose, Bagha Jatin, Sachindranath Sanyal, and Pratibha Lahiri, rise against the illegitimate Raj in British-occupied India. Two British officers vow to crush the armed rebellion, determined to reassert imperial power and crush a generation of young Indians willing to die for freedom.
overview.en: 1912. Four young revolutionaries, Rash Behari Bose, Bagha Jatin, Sachindranath Sanyal, and Pratibha Lahiri, rise against the illegitimate Raj in British-occupied India. Two British officers vow to crush the armed rebellion, determined to reassert imperial power and crush a generation of young Indians willing to die for freedom.

Based on a true story. When the Nazis invade Poland in late 1939, Harry Haft (Ben Foster) is sent to the Auschwitz extermination camp. He is a powerfully built man, so a charming but sadistic Nazi officer offers him an impossible deal: fight fellow prisoners in the boxing ring for the amusement of his captors, or die.

Lenny Belardo, the youngest and first American Pope in the history of the Church, must establish his new papacy and navigate the power struggles of the closed, secretive Vatican. Jude Law and Diane Keaton star in this eight part modern-day drama created by Academy Award winning director Paolo Sorrentino.

overview.de: Die beliebte HBO-Dramaserie von Macher Alan Ball („Six Feet Under") basiert auf den Sookie-Stackhouse-Erfolgsromanen von Charlaine Harris über eine kecke telepathische Kellnerin (Anna Paquin) in einer nahen Zukunft, in der Vampire unter uns leben.
overview.en: HBO hit drama series about a perky telepathic waitress (Anna Paquin) in a near-future in which vampires live among us.

Tutenstein is a ten-year-old boy mummy who is struck by lightning and brought back to life in a modern-day museum. A lot has changed in 3000 years, but one thing that hasn’t changed in all that time is the kid’s attitude: he still thinks he’s pharaoh! And through his experiences and adventures in the 21st Century, Tut learns how to be a better pharaoh... and friend.

title.de: Unternehmen Merkur - Die Schlacht um Kreta

overview.en: The documentary series about how the Norwegian government, through a covert operation, managed to smuggle 49 tons of gold out of the country during Nazi Germany's invasion of Norway in April, 1940.
A humble farmer leaves Algeria for the first time when his dream comes true to take his pride and joy to the Paris International Agricultural Show.

overview.de: Von der australischen Akademikerin zum weltweiten Meme: Breakdancerin „Raygun“ erzählt von ihrem Weg zur olympischen Bühne und dem Spott, der daraufhin folgte.
overview.en: Is Raygun a rebel, a villain or an impostor? Uncover the full story behind the Aussie breakdancer — and infamous Olympic meme — in this documentary.

overview.de: Für seine Darstellung des Jake LaMotta, ein umstrittener Profiboxer der 1940er Jahre, dessen Brutalität weit über den Ring hinausreichte, erhielt Robert De Niro den Oscar als bester Hauptdarsteller. Ein filmisches Meisterwerk mit Cathy Moriarty und Joe Pesci in Nebenrollen.
overview.en: Robert De Niro turns in a powerful performance as a boxer whose psychological and sexual complexities erupt into violence both in and out of the ring.

overview.de: Als Cristina und ihre Kinder wegen der Schulden ihres Vaters von einem Mafiaboss aus ihrem Haus geworfen werden, müssen sie alles wagen, um ihr Heim wiederzubekommen.
overview.en: A single mom and her three kids are thrown into chaos when their estranged, wealthy patriarch dies, revealing a will full of secrets and debts.
[With ENG Subtitles] A heart-wrenching story of a mother's unconditional love for her children amidst her economic plight in a harsh reality.

Yugi Moto solves an Ancient Egyptian Puzzle and brings forth a dark and powerful alter ego. Whenever he and his friends are threatened by evil in Duel Monster Card Game, this alter ego breaks out to save them.

overview.de: Sally und Gillian, gespielt von Sandra Bullock und Nicole Kidman, sind Schwestern, die unter einem Fluch leiden: Ihre Verehrer sterben. Sally möchte die Zauberei aufgeben, während Gillian ein abenteuerliches Leben führt.
overview.en: Two sisters (Sandra Bullock, Nicole Kidman) try to avoid a legacy of witchcraft.
When a corrupt judicial system lets a drunken driver off scott-free, four gym friends become vigilantes to avenge the death of their trainer.

Santhosh, a youth who is struggling with 'Micro Penis Syndrome' marries Amrutha in an unavoidable situation but continues to postpone their first night nuptials. He comes across a Godwoman who has a herbal medicine to address his problem which leads to a misunderstanding between him & his wife. How he resolves this situation with the help of a psychiatrist forms the crux of the story.
The hit and run of an 18-year-old girl raises many questions, but the truth is rarely pure and never simple.
A 40 year-old playboy's life turns upside down when he comes to know that he has a 20-something-year-old daughter; not only has he gained a daughter, but also soon a grandchild.

Trapped on Panhala fort, under siege and outnumbered against a vast Mughal army, the great king Shivaji makes his escape under the cover of darkness. In spite of every effort, Marathas find themselves at Ghod Khind with enemy in pursuit. Fearless warrior Bajiprabhu Deshpande urges his king to proceed to Vishalgad, and leave the rest to him.

Kabir agrees to travel to his native place to complete the legal formalities of his mother's properties. Reluctant to meet his father, Kabir is coaxed into taking a road trip with Dhungya and Dhairya. Will the journey be successful?

Three criminals, a runaway girl and her three best friends, an aspiring director and a star actor cross paths due to an incident. Will they come off better for it or worse? "Velle" depicts the journey of individuals or the common men, who inevitably find themselves amidst the chaos of life, only to realise that in the end everything falls into place - it all makes sense.
Satyameva Jayate 2 revolves around the fight against injustice and misuse of power. From police and politicians to industrialists and a common man, the film will explore corruption in all spheres.
A smart, quirky, geeky woman is a magnet for trouble. That's exactly what makes a struggling businessman fall for his fiancee's sister, but with so many hurdles, their love seems set for disaster.

Charlie is a young simpleton daydreamer, currently, a pizza delivery boy, who finds himself driving his uncle’s truck , Girnaar Express to deliver a gorilla from Mumbai to the jetty at Diu. Charlie is unaware that the gorilla is disguised business tycoon M.D.Makwana who is on the run after comitting a multi crore scam. It is a mad road journey that ends up making a hero out of a simpleton.
Bored traffic cop Shakti stumbles upon the skeletal remains of a family and probes into the matter, crossing paths with the original investigator of the case.
A young man from the Black Town of 1970’s segregated Madras finds himself with the opportunity to redeem his boxing clan and himself from years of defeat. Can he do it? Will he be allowed to?
This biopic charts the life of actor-turned-chief minister Jayaram Jayalalitha and the relationship paving her rapid yet complicated path to power.

Prabhu leads a happy life with his family until a vacation changes their life. A traumatic past finds its way back to him, which forces him to reconnect with his brother Kathir, whose darkness Prabhu was not able to handle in the past. Now Prabhu, the clueless, decides to go against all odds to save his only daughter from the clutches of evil, for which he is being tested to his limits.
Five youngsters, who are on the verge of committing suicide, happen to encounter zombies in a forest. Will they manage to escape?

With the impact on interpersonal relationships when two families in a small town choose to indulge in a multi-generational legal battle as it’s primary plot line, the story of ‘Anni Manchi Sakunamule’ is set in a fictional town of Victoriapuram and filmed in the scenic Nilgiris.

A hilarious misadventure of three buddies as they travel from Jogipet to Hyderabad in search for king size lives, instead tumble into a series of dangerous events brewing in the city. Jathi Ratnalu is the deadliest comedy you can see.

Sarkaru Vaari Paata is a story about Mahi (Mahesh Babu), who believes that financial discipline is a must have quality in everyone. What happens when he encounters Rajendranath who doesn`t respect money. Kalavathi (Keerthy Suresh) is the love interest of Mahi in this action drama.
Sathya pulls off bigger and bigger cons, and becomes a target for Interpol. ACP Kishore sets out on a mission to capture Sathya and take revenge.
The story unravels between the incidents that take place within four days of Joshi, a mobile shop owner, purchasing a new car owing to a marriage alliance that is almost fixed with Radha.

Joji, an engineering dropout and the youngest son of the rich plantation family lives with his aspirations of becoming a super wealthy NRI. But his father sees down on him as a proper loser. Driven by greed and blind ambition, Joji finally decide to execute his plans following an unexpected event in the family. Will he succeed in achieving his dreams?

Super Star Hareendran is Well Known for his Driving Skills and Craze towards Motor Cars. Kuruvila Joseph, the Motor Vehicle Inspector of the Town is a Die Hard Fan of Hareendran. To complete the shoot of his latest film Hareendran needs to submit his license, which he discovers is missing. In order to get a new license urgently, Hareendran goes to Kuruvilla, his biggest fan.
When a colleague lands a coveted job, a journalist throws away his moral principles and writes fabricated stories to become a major influencer.

John Baby,who is recouping from a traumatic accident,meets Nitin,a young boy who interests him with murder stories. When Baby explores the possibility of Nitin's stories by mapping the events,it matches with the real-time incidents.

title.en: Marakkar: Lion of the Arabian Sea

overview.en: The movie is a biopic on the real-life character, Kunjali Marakkar who is till date considered one of the greatest naval chiefs of India. An epic tale, set in the late 15th century and early16th century, the film is  based on the fearless seafarer of the Malabar Coast, Kunjali Marakkar.

Two cinema enthusiasts from a religious organization decide to make a movie in accordance to the religious understanding of permissible and forbidden. They find an experienced crew from the mainstream but they have reservations on the cast of the lead couple. The couple has to be married to each other so that behaving closer to each can be religiously permissible.

title.de: ゲーム・オブ・スパイ

overview.en: Japan is being targeted by criminals, and a group of secret agents (GOS) are secretly working to save the nation. They've got 72 hours to save Tokyo's 14 million residents from a terror attack by Mundo, a worldwide terrorist group. Can they do it in time? And what's Mundo's true goal? Watch as ninjas defeat their enemies using ancient ninja weapons in this exciting action film! (C) Toei Company

title.de: ヒガンバナ～女たちの犯罪ファイル
title.en: Higanbana - Women's Crime File (Higanbana: Onnatachi no Hanzai Fairu)

title.de: 地味にスゴイ! 校閲ガール・河野悦子

overview.en: [With ENG Subtitles] Etsuko's lifelong dream is to become an editor for a fashion magazine. She finally bags an offer from a large publishing house, only to find out that she's been assigned to the least glamorous department in the company--the Proofreading Department.

title.de: 東京ヴァンパイアホテル

overview.en: Manami goes out to celebrate her 22nd birthday with friends and narrowly misses being killed in a murder rampage. Manami runs for her life but is chased by K, a member of the Dracula clan, and Yamada, a Corvin, AKA Neo Vampire. Manami is the one prophesied to rescue the Dracula clan. What is K's mission? And Manami's fate? The battle between humans, Vampires and Neo Vampires begins. 2017 NIKKATSU

overview.de: Producto de un experimento fallido, una descendencia de anaconda mejorada genéticamente se regenera para crear pánico y destrucción dentro de la selva durante una expedición mortal para quien entre.
overview.en: Even though the two monster snakes from Anaconda: Offspring are dead, a trail of victim's blood confirms that a new generation of snakes has reached adulthood and is preying upon?EVERYTHING. John Rhys-Davies and Crystal Allen return in the fourth installment of the popular franchise.

title.de: Der Kandidat - Macht hat Ihren Preis

overview.de: Nicolas Cage als Kämpfer für die kleinen Leute: spannendes Politdrama, zugleich präzise Charakterstudie. - Golf von Mexiko, 2010: Vor der Küste steht eine Bohrinsel in Flammen und löst eine verheerende ökologische Katastrophe aus. In dieser Krise erntet der Abgeordnete Colin Price (Nicolas Cage) großen Beifall, als er sich für die kleinen Leute einsetzt, die nun um ihre Existenz kämpfen. Als pikante Details aus Prices Privatleben an die Öffentlichkeit kommen, droht jedoch ein handfester Skandal. Unter dem Druck flüchtet sich der Politiker mehr denn je in den Alkohol.
overview.en: Academy Award winner Nicolas Cage delivers a thrilling and powerful performance in this edge-of-your-seat political thriller.

overview.de: Ein Hund, der Soldaten in Afghanistan geholfen hat, kehrt in die USA zurück und wird von der Familie seines Hundeführers nach einer traumatischen Erfahrung adoptiert.
overview.en: Max is a coming-of-age story about a young teen from a family dealing with loss, who finds friendship, comfort and adventure with the heroic military dog of his fallen brother.
“20/20 Britain's Most Notorious Crime Investigations” reopens six renowned UK crime cases.

title.de: 36 Seconds: Portrait of a Hate Crime
title.en: 36 Seconds: Portrait of a Hate Crime

overview.en: In 2015, it took Craig Hicks 36 seconds to execute three Muslim-American students while eating dinner in their home in Chapel Hill, NC. The film charts the victims' families' agonizing overnight pivot from trauma to advocacy as they struggle to prevent their loved ones' deaths from being dismissed as the result of a random parking dispute.
Deep in the Arizona desert before Area 51, the military discovers a hidden gem that helps them cover up the UFO surge and create Project Blue Book.
Five friends come together at a house party to countdown the New Year. Outside, a worldwide epidemic unfolds, barricading them inside.

From an age-old tale, in Dark Ages Britain, a powerful druid is bent on destroying the Celts. Arthur, a banished warrior, and Merlin, a hermit wizard, embark on a heroic quest to stop the druid and save their people.
When tornadoes hit a nuclear power plant, catastrophe is unleashed on a small town. Can anyone stop this path of destruction before it’s too late?
An idealistic scientist goes to India to sell genetically modified rice, but things change when she falls in love with a local farmer and the locale.
Bigfoot’s now a big deal. So when he goes missing, his shy but tech-savvy teen son must take on an evil CEO to save his family and a wildlife preserve.

title.de: Blow Out - Der Tod löscht alle Spuren

overview.de: Sehen Sie John Travolta als Tontechniker für Low-Budget-Horrorfilme. Bei der Aufzeichnung von Windeffekten nimmt er den tödlichen Autounfall eines Präsidentschaftskandidaten auf. War das Geräusch ein geplatzer Reifen oder der Schuss vom Attentäter?
overview.en: A Philadelphia sound-effects man records a car crash, only to realize it was a politically motivated murder that draws him into a dangerous plot.

title.de: Blue State - Eine Reise ins Blaue

overview.en: A fed-up Democrat hits the road to Canada with a mysterious traveling companion following the 2004 re-election of President George W. Bush.

overview.de: Broadchurch ist eine 8-teilige Dramaserie, in der untersucht wird, wie sich der Mord an einem Jungen - Danny Price - auf eine kleine Marktstadt in Dorset auswirkt. Es wird untersucht, was mit dieser kleinen Community passiert, wenn sie plötzlich im Mittelpunkt eines Großereignisses steht und dem vollen Glanz des Medienrampenlichts ausgesetzt ist.
overview.en: A community in Dorset, England, becomes the focus of a grisly murder investigation.

title.de: Capitan Alatriste - Mit Dolch und Degen

overview.en: En un clima de enfrentamientos, traición, romance y secretos, un espadachín a sueldo se alza contra los abusos en la Edad de Oro del Imperio Español.
Freed from prison, ruthless triad boss Kwok launches a revenge campaign that leads to an epic showdown between an old associate and his own brother.

overview.de: Das Porträt einer Region entlang der Ufer der Memel, geprägt durch die russische Invasion der Ukraine, Covid-19 und die Spuren des Holocausts.
overview.en: Das Porträt einer Region entlang der Ufer der Memel, geprägt durch die russische Invasion der Ukraine, Covid-19 und die Spuren des Holocausts.
Rock and Roll biopic starring Trainspotting's Ewen Bremner as Alan McGee, the maverick who created Creation Records and introduced Oasis to the world.

An ex-con and his four female friends plot to steal millions of dollars from the Chicago Transit Authority. A wary detective suspects the worse and struggles to prove that something reprehensible is afoot.

overview.de: A fast-talking attorney discovers he can't tell a lie for 24 hours after his 5-year-old son makes a birthday wish. He must try to keep his practice and life in one piece when his inappropriately candid mouth would have him ruined.
overview.en: A lawyer is forced to tell nothing but the truth for 24 hours when his neglected son's birthday wish comes true.

In Mexico, an American cowboy (Guy Madison) and local ranch hand (Carlos Rivas) discover cattle are going missing on land near Hollow Mountain… an impenetrable swamp where, stories have it, dwells a living prehistoric Tyrannosaurus rex.
Un padre de familia lucha por sostener su inocencia pese a las pruebas en su contra al determinarse que su esposa murio envenenada con arsénico.

When a Mexican gunslinger (Anthony Quinn) rids a town of several notorious gunfighters, he is named the sheriff, but must win over the rest of the residents who are yet to warm to his hard-hitting ways. Katy Jurado and Peter Whitney co-star.

title.de: Der Unbestechliche - Ein Cop rechnet ab

overview.en: Un duro policía de Nueva York se desilusiona con la corrupción y la codicia. Regresa a su ciudad natal en busca de consuelo, pero descubre algo más.

overview.de: Die beliebte Gruselfamilie ist zurück! Verzweifelt darüber, dass ihre Kinder erwachsen werden, packen Morticia und Gomez Wednesday, Pugsley und Onkel Fester für einen letzten Familienurlaub in den Spuk-Camper. Was soll da schiefgehen?
overview.en: The Addams Family embarks on an adventurous road trip in a hideous and humongous camper.

overview.de: In einer zukünftigen Welt sind die Bürger der von der Außenwelt abgeschotteten Stadt Chicago in fünf Gruppen unterteilt. Die selbstlosen Altruan regieren, die kämpferischen Ferox stellen die Polizei, die gelehrten Ken sind Wissenschaftler, die freimütigen Candor kümmern sich um die Justiz, und die freundlichen Amite haben die Landwirtschaft übernommen. Im Alter von 16 Jahren muss sich jeder Einwohner für eine Fraktion entscheiden. Beatrice Prior (Shailene Woodley) entdeckt bei einem obligatorischen Test, dass sie sich mehreren Gruppen zugehörig fühlt. Doch solche Menschen gelten als Bedrohung.
overview.en: In a future society, people are divided into factions based on their personalities. After a young woman learns she is a Divergent and will never fit into any one group, she uncovers a conspiracy to destroy all those like her.
When Marshal Wyatt Earp kills outlaw gangsters in a brawl, their leader aims to kill his brother in revenge. Doc Holliday lends the lawman a hand.
Un joven, nacido de una violación cometida por un vampiro legendario contra una mujer viva, jura encontrar y derrotar a su padre.
After seeing the unbelievable, two small-town teenagers and their teacher attempt to warn the authorities of an impending alien invasion.

overview.de: Sie kommen aus Dogtown, einem heruntergekommen Viertel im kalifornischen Venice, und prägen in den 70ern eine revolutionäre neue Trend-Sportart: das Skateboarden.
overview.en: See how extreme sports got its start with this critically-acclaimed, true-life story of three teenage surfers and best friends in Venice, California, who radicalized the sport of skateboarding in the1970s.

overview.de: "Dune“ erzählt von Paul Atreides, einem jungen Mann, der zu Höherem bestimmt ist und der sich zum gefährlichsten Planeten des Universums begibt, um die Zukunft seines Volkes zu sichern.
overview.en: A mythic and emotionally charged hero's journey, "Dune" tells the story of Paul Atreides, a brilliant and gifted young man born into a great destiny beyond his understanding, who must travel to the most dangerous planet in the universe to ensure the future of his family and his people. As malevolent forces explode into conflict over the planet's exclusive supply of the most precious resource in...

overview.de: Dune: Part Two erkundet die mythische Reise von Paul Atreides, der sich mit Chani und den Fremen vereint, während er sich auf einen Kreuzzug der Rache gegen die Verschwörer begibt, die seine Familie zerstört haben. Er steht vor der Wahl zwischen der Liebe seines Lebens und dem Schicksal des bekannten Universums und versucht, eine schreckliche Zukunft zu verhindern, die nur er vorhersehen kann.
overview.en: Paul Atreides unites with Chani and the Fremen while seeking vengeance for the death of his family.

title.de: El uno, el otro y los de más allá
title.en: The One, The Other And Those From Beyond

overview.en: Catalan women defy stereotypes in mountaineering history, breaking barriers in sports and society.
During a deep-space research mission, an astrophysicist, his wife, and their daughter become hostages on their own craft by a deranged killer.

Xhafer, a Kosovan immigrant living in Germany, returns home from work to find that someone has hung a dead rat at his front gate. Xhafer begins to feel persecuted by his colleagues, which plunges him into an identity crisis.

overview.de: Vier Beobachter verschwinden auf See - der versteckte Preis des Thunfischs.
overview.en: An investigation into overfishing takes an unexpected turn uncovering disappearances and deaths of fishery observers within a billion-dollar industry.

title.de: Fito Páez: El mundo cabe en una canción
title.en: Fito Páez: The World Within a Song

overview.de: Mit beispiellosen Einblicken zeigt diese intime Doku den argentinischen Rockstar Fito Páez von seiner ehrlichsten Seite, während er über Leben, Liebe und Musik reflektiert.
overview.en: With unprecedented access, this intimate documentary shows Argentinian rock star Fito Páez at his most candid as he reflects on life, love and music.

title.de: Girlfriend Experience - Aus dem Leben eines Luxus-Callgirls

overview.en: Adult film star Sasha Grey goes mainstream in Steven Soderbergh's movie about a high class call girl. Chelsea is on the up - she makes $2,000 an hour and her devoted boyfriend accepts her lifestyle.

overview.de: Tamara heuert einen Veteranen einer Spezialeinheit an, um ihren Bruder, einen Geschäftsmann und Ex-Boxer, vor einem Musik-Mogul zu beschützen, der blutige Rache geschworen hat.
overview.en: An ex-combat Desert Storm veteran is hired as a bodyguard by a former boxing champ to protect his family against a rap music mogul and an ex-con.

Lasse Hallström's Hilma portrays an unconventional woman, who was posthumously recognized as the pioneer of abstract art. Starring Lena Olin, we follow Hilma's spiritual awakening after the loss of her beloved younger sister, her unconventional love life, and the impetus behind her work, from the writings of Rudolph Steiner to the strong influence of the Theosophic Movement.

overview.de: Ein ehemaliger Feuerwehrmann steckt in einem brennenden Kaufhaus fest und reflektiert sein Leben.
overview.en: There are tears and thrills in this saga about Baltimore fireman Jack Morrison whose life flashes before him when he becomes trapped in a blazing high rise. He remembers being a rookie, his first fire, bonding with fellow firemen, falling in love, his relationship with the fire chief and what the job means to him.
After his mission is exposed, a CIA operative and his Afghan translator must escape hostile territory to reach extraction in Kandahar.
Friends recount the Mandalorian and Grogu's many adventures.
The 21st century... after the nuclear holocaust. Plunderers threaten the non-desert oasis of Lost Wells, which is inhabited by a group of flower children. Who will save these "villagers?"
Duty calls again for our hero dog Max as he returns to action for his new assignment serving on the Secret Service detail of U.S. President Bennett.

title.de: Murder in the Skies: Who Downed Mh17?
title.en: Murder in the Skies: Who Downed Mh17?

overview.en: 1937. Two truck drivers, fired from a corrupt firm, start their own company. Their former boss, concerned about competition, attempts to drive them out of business, including seducing their daughter and having henchmen sabotage their trucks.
An actress's journey through the world of adult film sheds light on work life and power dynamics in Britain's porn industry in the age of webcams.

overview.de: Monkey D. Ruffy durchsegelt mit seinen Strohhut-Piraten die Grandline, um den Schatz One Piece zu finden und neuer König der Piraten zu werden.
overview.en: Monkey D. Luffy sails the high seas in search of the One Piece left by the pirate king, Gold Roger.
1962. An ex-con is the prime suspect when a series of murders occur under the full moon, every victim a young blonde woman.

title.de: Running Wild - Der Preis der Freiheit

overview.en: Following the untimely death of her husband, widower Stella must figure out a way to keep her family ranch open after finding out she is heavily in debt. Stumbling upon a group of wild horses that wandered onto her property, she enlists the help of rancher Brannon to bring these horses back to health. An ex-con, Brannon calls in a favor and enrolls the ranch in the Prep program; a program that ..
Después de que su amiga es encontrada muerta, una mujer descubre que su amiga es víctima de un asesino que atrae a las mujeres a través de anuncios.
A troubled Iraq War veteran struggling to reintegrate into society embarks on a cross-country journey with the hope of reuniting with his young son.

From Iran to Turkey and finally Nepal. Speed mountaineering and WWF ambassador Benedikt Boehm and his new nepalese adventure partner Prakash Sherpa take us to discover the biodiversity of Nepal. From the heat of the jungle among rhinos, tigers and hippos to the highest peaks in the world, this new speed challenge against time leads us to discover wonderful people and unexpected wild life

title.de: Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu

overview.de: Das böse Imperium wurde gestürzt, imperiale Warlords sind jedoch weiterhin über die ganze Galaxis verstreut. Die junge Neue Republik schützt alles, wofür die Rebellion gekämpft hat und nimmt dafür die Hilfe des Mandalorianers Din Djarin (Pedro Pascal) und seines jungen Schützlings Grogu in Anspruch. Einige Sequenzen mit blinkenden Lichtern können bei sensiblen Zuschauern Reaktionen auslösen.
overview.en: The evil Empire has fallen, and Imperial warlords are scattered throughout the galaxy. As the fledgling New Republic works to protect everything the Rebellion fought for, they enlist the help of Mandalorian Din Djarin (Pedro Pascal) and his young apprentice Grogu. Some flashing lights sequences or patterns may affect photosensitive viewers.

overview.de: Seit 1977 schwebt die Raumkapsel "Voyager 2" durchs Weltall. Ihre Mission: Lebewesen auf anderen Planeten von der Existenz der Erde zu berichten und sie zu uns einzuladen. Jetzt ist der ersten Gast da: Starman - der liebenswerteste Außerirdische seit Galaxis-Gnom E.T. Doch statt Pauken und Trompeten empfängt die Air Force ihn mit Bomben und Raketen.
overview.en: John Carpenter's Starman is a spellbinding mix of gentle humour, romance and science fiction wizardry. Jeff Bridges received an Oscar nomination as Best Actor (1984), and Karen Allen provides excellent co-starring support. An alien explorer from a far-off planet plummets to Earth. His unearthly masters give him three days to live as a man - and then he must return. In those three days he learns..

From Henri Verneuil comes a captivating conspiracy thriller about a young journalist who uncovers an assassination plot hatched by an American multinational company intent on taking over several French industries. He aims to gather enough evidence to expose the American corporation for what it really is, before French companies start to disappear—along with their employees.

Fear has found a new home. Kyle is a shadow of her former self. Struggling to overcome the death of her older brother, Jamie, she has withdrawn into herself, cutting off from her friends and putting her life on pause. Now, a year on, her college friends have persuaded Kyle back into the world.

title.de: The Couple Next Door - Paare mit Geheimnissen

overview.de: Für Evie und Pete scheint das Leben perfekt. Sie ziehen in ihr neues Haus, ein Baby ist unterwegs und mit ihren neuen Nachbarn schließen sie schnell Freundschaft. Doch hinter den noblen Vorhängen verbergen sich dunkle Geheimnisse.
overview.en: A young couple develop a fast friendship with their new neighbors when they move to an idyllic suburb; but the relationship soon takes some unexpected and sinister turns.

title.de: The Girl of the Golden West
title.en: The Girl of the Golden West

overview.en: A group of friends head to a cabin in the woods, where a meteorite crash triggers a series of terrifying events, all captured on a hidden camera.

overview.de: Diese epische zehnteilige Miniserie über den wahren brutalen Kampf dreier Marinesoldaten im Pazifik im 2. Weltkrieg stammt von den Produzenten der mit dem Emmy(R) und Golden Globe(R) 2001 ausgezeichneten HBO-Miniserie "Band of Brothers“(R).
overview.en: The epic 10-part HBO miniseries that tells the true stories of three Marines fighting in the brutal Pacific theater during WWII.

overview.de: In dem Psychothriller "The Runner" wird das Leben von Maia Marten (Gal Gadot), einer Londoner Anwältin, durch einen Anruf während ihres morgendlichen Laufs aus den Fugen gerissen: Ihr Sohn wurde entführt. Um ihn zurückzubekommen, muss sie weiterlaufen, jeden skrupellosen Befehl befolgen und niemandem vertrauen. Jede Sekunde ist eine Prüfung dafür, wie weit eine Mutter für ihr Kind gehen würde.
overview.en: In the psychological thriller The Runner, Maia Marten (Gal Gadot), a brilliant London lawyer, has her life shattered by a single call on her morning run: her son has been taken. To get him back, she must keep running, obey every ruthless command, and trust no one-each second a test of how far a mother will go to save her child.
In 2248, dormant C40 team members are awakened by an AI control system to execute a top-secret mission to destroy all medicine in a gene research lab.
After a botched heist, three thieves break into a house to hide, where they discover a family inside. But the biggest threat is yet to arrive.

overview.de: Als ihre geliebten Trolle von hungrigen Bergen verschleppt werden, beginnt für Prinzessin Poppy und ihren grummeligen Kumpel Branch das Abenteuer ihres Lebens.
overview.en: When their village is invaded by the Bergens, Poppy and Branch must work together to save the day.

overview.de: Mit intimen Interviews, privatem Filmmaterial und freigegebenen Aufnahmen zeigt diese Dokumentation, wie die Spätfolgen des 11. Septembers auch 25 Jahre später noch nachhallen.
overview.en: With intimate interviews, personal recordings and declassified footage, this documentary reveals how the legacy of 9/11 still reverberates 25 years later.
Opposing attorneys go head-to-head in a blistering courtroom battle when a Tennessee teacher is forced to defend himself for teaching Darwinism.
When six old friends embark on a camping trip deep in the wilderness, one of them ends up dead and the rest begin to turn on each other.

When delinquent Yusuke dies saving someone else, he gets a second shot at life as a Spirit Detective. With his former rival, Kuwabara, and demons Kurama and Hiei, Yusuke takes on the monsters and humans who desire to rule the three realms of reality.
This film looks at a zoo closure and a case in which an orangutan was declared a “Non-Human Person,” forever changing the animal rights landscape.

overview.de: Als eine Mutter bei einer Entführung ihr Augenlicht und ihre Tochter verliert, nimmt sie die Dinge selbst in die Hand, um die Verantwortlichen zur Rechenschaft zu ziehen.
overview.en: When a mother loses her eyesight and her daughter in a kidnapping, she takes matters into her own hands to hunt down those responsible.
In this apocalyptic sci-fi thriller, a meteor is heading straight for earth -- and the world's population has just three days left to live.

A self-styled accident choreographer, Ho Kwok-fai, The Brain, is a professional hit man who kills his victims by trapping them in well-crafted accidents that look like unfortunate mishaps but are in fact perfectly staged acts of crime.

title.de: Anubhav Singh Bassi: Bas Kar Bassi
title.en: Anubhav Singh Bassi: Bas Kar Bassi

overview.en: Fresh out of national law university, Bassi arrives in Delhi as a young lawyer with dreams, ambition and friends. All he needs is some perspective and a lot of money but timing and bosses keep getting in his way. He relates the story of his odyssey with defining career decisions and celebrations of wins and losses, in the midst of the incredible comedy that has been his life.
A teenage outcast gets targeted by a group of high-school jocks, who hatch a scheme to humiliate her, but instead trigger her terrifying powers.

overview.de: Dieser überhaus unterhaltsame Film voller Humor, Spannung und unheimlicher Überraschungen stammt aus der Amblin-Entertainment-Schmiede von Regisseur Brad Silberling und Produzent Steven Spielberg. “Geisterpsychologe” Dr. James Harvey (Bill Pullman) und seine Tochter Kat (Christina Ricci) ziehen in das zugige alte Schloss Whipstaff Manor, dessen geldgierige Besitzerin Carrigan Crittendon (Cathy Moriarty) Harvey engagiert hat, um den verfallenen Landsitz von seinen Geistern zu befreien. Dabei handelt es sich um einen freundlichen, einsamen jungen Geist namens Casper, der sich nights mehr wünscht als einen guten Freund, und seine ziemlich rabiaten Onkel Stretch, Stinkie und Fatso. Wenn alles nach Plan läuft, können Carrigan und ihr aalglatter Freund Dibs (Eric Idle) sich endlich den berühmten Schatz von Whipstaff Manor unter den Nagel reißen. Casper und Kat freunden sich sofort an, doch die schaurigen Onkel dulden keine Lebendigen in ihrem Haus. ‘Casper’ ist eine gelungene Abenteuerkomödie für die ganze Familie.
overview.en: A teen who lost her mother befriends a friendly ghost named Casper while staying at the haunted mansion of a mean heiress.

title.de: Der perfekte Sommertag mit Stitch & Angel

title.en: The Bridge on the River Kwai

overview.de: Im Zweiten Weltkrieg errichten britische Kriegsgefangene in einem japanischen Lager eine wichtige Eisenbahnbrücke, während ein Team der Alliierten deren Sprengung plant.
overview.en: In this Oscar-winning classic, a British colonel and his men are ordered to build a bridge for their Japanese captors — but the Allies have other plans.

title.de: Die Tribute von Panem – Catching Fire

overview.de: Mit ihrem unverhofften Sieg bei den 74. Hungerspielen haben Katniss und Peeta (Jennifer Lawrence, Josh Hutcherson) die Regeln des Kapitols verletzt. In den Distrikten kommt Unruhe auf. Präsident Snow (Donald Sutherland) droht Katniss, Unheil über ihre Familie zu bringen, wenn sie es nicht schafft, bei der Tour der Sieger die erhitzen Gemüter zu besänftigen. Dann ändert Snow die Spielregeln: Die Sieger der vergangenen Hungerspiele sollen diesmal gegeneinander antreten ... - Die Hungerspiele gehen weiter, doch jetzt sind die Regeln noch mörderischer: Jennifer Lawrence und Josh Hutcherson im zweiten Teil der packenden Sci-Fi-Actionreihe.
overview.en: After their unprecedented victory in the 74th Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen and Peeta Mellark embark on a Victors Tour. Katniss senses rebellion is stirring, but a cruel change in the upcoming 75th Hunger Games may change Panem forever.

title.de: Die Tribute von Panem – Mockingjay Teil 1

overview.de: Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) ist im bunkerartigen Rebellen-Distrikt 13 in Sicherheit. Doch sie scheint gebrochen. Denn ihr Hungerspiele-Partner Peeta (Josh Hutcherson) ist als Propaganda-Geisel in die Hände des Kapitols gefallen. Nur widerwillig erklärt sich Katniss bereit, in kämpferischen Videos als Symbol des Widerstands zu agieren. Bis ein grausamer Angriff von Kapitol-Präsident Snows Geschwader auf ein Krankenhaus ihren Kampfgeist neu entfacht. - Vor dem großen Knall: der psychologisch spannende Teil 1 des "Panem"-Finales mit einer herausragenden Jennifer Lawrence.
overview.en: Spreading her wings as Mockingjay, Katniss leads the rebellion in the war against President Snow.

title.de: Die Tribute von Panem – Mockingjay Teil 2

overview.de: Katniss und ihr Team versuchen in einer letzten geheimen Mission, Präsident Snow zu töten.
overview.en: The nation of Panem finds itself in a full scale war.

title.de: Die Tribute von Panem – The Hunger Games

overview.de: In einer dystopischen Zukunft kämpft ein junges Mädchen in einer tödlichen TV-Show ums Überleben und wird zum Symbol des Widerstands.
overview.en: In a dystopian future, Katniss Everdeen voluntarily takes her younger sister's place in the Hunger Games, a televised fight to the death in which two teenagers from each of the twelve Districts of Panem compete. Pitted against Tributes who have prepared for these Games their entire lives, Katniss is forced to rely on her sharp instincts and the mentorship of former victor Haymitch Abernathy.

overview.de: Diese Reality-Serie folgt der offenen, chaotischen Content-Creatorin Alix Earle, wie sie die Höhen und Tiefen einer modernen Familie und ihrer blitzartigen Karriere durchlebt.
overview.en: Alix Earle, Gen Z's ultimate "It" girl, gets real in this unscripted, unfiltered series that goes behind the scenes of her life and family.

Undertaker Cedric Brown is again faced with an almost impossible task: He has to look for a nanny for his seven naughty children within a very short time, who have only had pranks and mischief on their minds since their mother's death. After the employment agency rejects him again, one night, the gruesome nanny Mcphee knocks on the door. The children want to get rid of this nanny too, but they begin to behave as if by magic. When their nasty great-aunt Adelaide wants the house back, the children have to work with Nanny McPhee to prevent the worst.

title.de: Eine zauberhafte Nanny - Knall auf Fall in ein neues Abenteuer
title.en: Nanny McPhee and the Big Bang

overview.en: The mysterious Nanny McPhee only appears when she's needed the most and wanted the least. This time, she finds herself at a family farm to teach her charges five new lessons.

overview.de: In dieser historischen Dramaserie lässt sich Emilia, die bei einer unkonventionellen Familie aus Freigeistern aufgewachsen ist, ihre Zukunft nicht von Traditionen vorschreiben.
overview.en: Society expects her to marry a doctor… so Emilia becomes one instead as love and war reshape her life. Based on the acclaimed novel by Ángeles Mastretta.
This documentary profiles the Veterans Airlift Command, a volunteer group whose pilots fly former soldiers across the US for treatment.

A bold prelude to Laclos’ classic 18th century novel focusing on the origin story of how his iconic characters, the Marquise de Merteuil and the Vicomte de Valmont, met as passionate young lovers in Paris on the eve of the revolution.

overview.de: Ein Afroamerikaner erlebt in einer liberalen weißen Familie die Hölle: Oscargekrönter Horror-Überraschungshit, der listig in den Abgrund hinter der Toleranz blickt. - Mit etwas Unbehagen reist Chris (Daniel Kaluuya) mit Freundin Rose (Allison Williams) erstmals zu deren Eltern. Toll - die reagieren nicht im Geringsten auf die Überraschung, dass Chris Afroamerikaner ist. Doch irgendetwas stimmt nicht in dem scheinbar so liberalen Haushalt: Die beiden schwarzen Hausangestellten verhalten sich eigenartig und Roses Mama (Catherine Keener) will Chris gleich am ersten Abend hypnotisieren. Bald findet er sich in einem grotesken, brutalen Alptraum wieder ...
overview.en: A young photographer uncovers a dark secret when he meets his girlfriend's seemingly friendly parents for the first time at their posh estate.

overview.de: Diese epische Serie spielt 200 Jahre vor der Handlung von Game of Thrones und erzählt die Geschichte des Hauses Targaryen.
overview.en: Set 200 years before the events of Game of Thrones, this epic series tells the story of House Targaryen.

With a little help from his school friends, the wannabe bad-boy Kabir, and the color-blind but doesn't know it Susu, Dhruv sets out to woo the first crush of his life, the feisty, out-of-his-league class topper, Chhavi. Venturing out of their childhood, in their last years of school, the trio find their first drink, pick their first fight and mend their first broken heart.

overview.de: Nach einem gescheiterten Auftrag in Mosambik zieht sich der MI7-Topspion Johnny English (Rowan Atkinson) fernab der Zivilisation nach Tibet zurück, um sich von der peinlichen Schmach zu erholen. Doch es dauert nicht lange, bis seine Dienste wieder gefragt sind: Das Leben des chinesischen Premierministers ist in Gefahr, und dadurch droht ein nuklearer Krieg. Gut, dass der Geheimagent sich noch von einem tibetischen Mönch in asiatischer Kampfkunst hat unterweisen lassen. Johnny English ist bereit für seine nächste Mission.
overview.en: Rowan Atkinson returns to the role of the accidental secret agent who doesn’t know fear or danger in the comedy spy-thriller Johnny English Reborn. In this adventure, the most unlikely intelligence officer in Her Majesty’s Secret Service must stop a group of international assassins before they eliminate a Chinese leader and cause global chaos.

overview.de: Der Moderator einer satirischen Polit-Talkshow kandidiert als Präsident, um die Korruption der Regierung anzuprangern. Doch der Stunt wird bitterer Ernst, als er die Wahl gewinnt.
overview.en: A comedian who hosts a satirical news program decides to make a run for president and a computerized voting machine malfunction gets him elected.

overview.de: Die Karten werden neu gemischt, als zwei verfeindete Verbrecherfamilien in einer Schlacht aneinandergeraten, die Imperien zu stürzen droht. Harry Da Souza, ein gewiefter Mann fürs Grobe, gerät ins Kreuzfeuer und stellt seine Loyalität unter Beweis.
overview.en: Two mob families clash in a war that threatens to topple empires and lives.
A Catholic French couple sees their life upside down when their four daughters get married to men of different religion and origins.

overview.de: Regisseur Steve Bendelack schickt unseren liebsten Tollpatsch Mr. Bean in den Urlaub nach Südfrankreich, wo er bei den Filmfestspielen von Cannes für reichlich Chaos sorgt.
overview.en: Mr. Bean is heading to the South of France for a simple holiday in the sun. His voyage from London to the Riviera soon transcends into one of mischief and mayhem! Mr. Bean inadvertently creates havoc wherever he goes. This culminates in an unscheduled and riotous screening of his own video diary at the Cannes Film Festival.

overview.de: Der kultigen Teddy im Duffle-Coat macht wieder London unsicher. In seinem zweiten Filmabenteuer jagt der Kuschel-Bär den Dieb eines seltenen Buches. Mit der deutschen Stimme von Elyas M'Barek.
overview.en: Paddington must use his detective skills to catch a book thief in this fun-filled sequel.

The legendary Sam Raimi and director Gil Kenan contemporize this chilling classic tale about a family whose home is haunted by evil forces which attack and hold the youngest daughter captive. Can the family save her before she disappears forever?

overview.de: Als ein Experiment schief geht, stiften Superkreaturen in der Stadt Chaos. Wissenschaftler Davis bemüht sich um ein Gegenmittel, um den Affen zu retten, der einst sein Freund war.
overview.en: Three gigantic, mutated beasts embark on a path of destruction when a genetic experiment goes wrong.

Amidst the harsh glare of one of the most fiercely debated stories in all of sports, LSU student athletes Olivia Dunne, Jayden Daniels, Angel Reese, Flau'jae Johnson, Alia Armstrong and Trace Young navigate the uncharted waters of Name, Image and Likeness ("NIL").
A Los Angeles cop whose career went down in disgrace has a chance to do right when a child is abducted and he must go through dark depths to find him.

overview.de: Keanu Reeves ist ein Weltraumkurier, der eingesteckt, angeschaltet und programmiert ist, die wichtigsten Daten des 21. Jahrhundert zu liefern, die direkt in sein Gehirn geleitet werden! Eine rasante Achterbahnfahrt vollgepackt mit Action und schlagzäher Bildsprache! Außerdem in den Hauptrollen sind Dolph Lundgren, Takeshi, Ice-T, Dina Meyer und Henry Rollins.
overview.en: A high-tech courier with stolen data in his chip-implanted brain is on the run from a global crime syndicate.
Seven years after the case related to Vijay and his family was closed, a series of unexpected events brings a truth to light that threatens to change everything for the Salgaonkars.
Mark,the son of gangster Antony,finds a telephone that has the ability to contact the past.

An orphan soldier, Lieutenant Ram's life changes, after he gets a letter from a girl named Sita. He meets her and love blossoms between them. When he comes back to his camp in Kashmir,After he gets caught in jail, he sends a letter to Sita which won't reach her.

Kranti Rayanna, a businessman, comes back to India after 20 years to celebrate his school's centenary function. During this, he learns that there is a large mafia working to close government schools and privatise education for their profits. How Kranti fights against this mafia forms the rest of the story.

In the heart of 'Sapta Sagaradaache Ello’ (Somewhere Beyond the Seven Seas), lies an ardent love story between Manu & Priya. Their journey, set against the backdrop of a city's shadows, delves into the depths of their emotions. In a world where promises hold weight and fate’s grasp is firm, how far will Manu go to fulfil his promise? What becomes of love when destiny triggers an unexpected turn?

overview.de: Spitzenchirurgin Michiko muss im Ausland das Leben eines Präsidenten retten, hat mit einem neuen Klinikdirektor zu kämpfen und stellt sich den Rätseln ihrer Vergangenheit.
overview.en: Michiko Daimon saves the life of a foreign president. Totei Hospital's new director, Hiroto Kozu, is a skilled surgeon, and his twin brother, Takato, has financial backing. But Hiroto's expression changes when he meets Akira. Morimoto learns the secret of Daimon's past. Soon Michiko faces a crisis! She's prepared to take on the "Devil's Operation". title.de: 岸辺露伴 ルーヴルへ行く

overview.en: Rohan Kishibe is a mangaka who can read people like a book. At work on a new creation, Rohan recalls a tale of the blackest painting ever made. Called the most evil of paintings, it used a paint that should not exist. Driven by the events linked to it, Rohan and his editor, Izumi, go to the Louvre in France for answers.©2023 "Rohan at the Louvre" Film Partners ©LUCKY LAND COMMUNICATIONS/SHUEISHA

overview.de: Die Brüder Todd und Jan bilden eine wilde Truppe aus mindestens so trinkfesten wie schrägen Vögeln und trainieren für die Olympi ade der Biertrinker.
overview.en: In this comedy from the director of The Dukes Of Hazzard, two brotherstravel to Germany for Oktoberfest and stumble upon a super-secret,centuries-old competition.

overview.de: In Philadelphia will ein Kinderpsychologe einem Jungen helfen, der angeblich Tote sieht. Die Wahrheit ist erschreckender, als er sich je vorstellen kann.
overview.en: A child psychologist discovers a patient's incredible sixth sense.

overview.de: Kiyotaka Ayanokōji ist jüngst der fördernden weiterführenden Schule der Stadt Tōkyō beigetreten.
overview.en: On the surface, Koudo Ikusei Senior High School is a utopia. The students enjoy an unparalleled amount of freedom, and it is ranked highly in Japan. However, the reality is less than ideal. Four classes, A through D, are ranked in order of merit, and only the top classes receive favorable treatment. Kiyotaka Ayanokouji is a student of Class D, where the school dumps its worst.

overview.de: Starring comedian Nate Bargatze as salesman Nate Wilcox and Mandy Moore as his wife, Katie. To Nate and their three children, Katie is the ultimate mom. But when her household invention leads to a once-in-a-lifetime deal on Shark Tank and takes her on a prolonged business trip, Nate must figure out how to keep the house from (literally) falling apart. Welcome to the dad era.

title.de: 'Tis the Season: The Holidays on Screen
title.en: 'Tis the Season: The Holidays on Screen

overview.en: A celebration of beloved holiday films and TV specials; featuring decades of rich archival footage and interviews with the celebrities, directors and pop culture experts unwrapping the most memorable and festive moments on screen.
During the waning era of prohibition, two women witness a murder and go on the run, finding protection from a pair of retired contract killers.
Scientists create a genetically engineered sabretooth cat and must hunt it down after it escapes and begins eating innocent people.
When his daughter is kidnapped by a cult leader, a hitman-turned-church reverend is forced to wrestle with his faith in his quest for vengeance.
When a woman falls victim to a strange illness, her fiancé turns to his former professor and rival to help him uncover the terrifying vampiric truth.
After unsuspecting residents of a small Texas town become prey to a vicious lake-dwelling shark, locals attempt to kill the creature.
When the gas station she works at is held at gunpoint, Melinda finds an opportunity to make a connection with the robber, regardless of who gets hurt.
An aspiring chef finds herself pitted against her boss in an ice sculpting contest after a childhood acquaintance enrolls her in the competition.

title.de: City Hunter The Movie: Angel Dust
title.en: City Hunter the Movie: Angel Dust

overview.en: Based in Shinjuku, Ryo Saeba, a talented disposal shop "City Hunter" who solves various requests, and his partner, Kaori Makimura, are asked by a female video creator, Angie, to find an escaped cat. A request comes in. Meanwhile, Saeko Nogami of the Metropolitan Police Department, with the help of Umibozu and Miki, begins an investigation into the invention of the biotech company Zoltic.
In the aftermath of the apocalypse caused by a deadly mist, one woman seeks out the truth about the organization she's worked for her whole life.
A self-absorbed realtor enlists the help of his neighbor when he's suddenly left in charge of the granddaughter he never knew existed until his estranged son drops her off at his home.

title.en: Max Winslow and The House of Secrets

overview.en: Five teenagers compete to win a billionaire scientist's mansion by facing off against the super computer that controls it.

Hannah McKenzie runs a side business on wedding dress when she's not busy with her job at salon. When Will Millington, heir to the bridal empire comes in looking to revamp the brand. These two work together and perhaps even fall in love.

overview.de: Eine schaurig nette Familie: In seinem ersten animierten Kinoabenteuer zieht der eigenwillige Gruselclan in ein neues Zuhause - und versucht, sich in die Nachbarschaft einzufügen.
overview.en: The Addams family encounter a shady TV personality who despises their eerie hilltop mansion.

overview.de: Tris, Four und einige Verbündete überwinden die Barriere und verlassen das umkämpfte Chicago.
overview.en: Beatrice Prior and Tobias Eaton venture into the world outside of the fence and are taken into protective custody by a mysterious agency known as the Bureau of Genetic Welfare, in the third and final part of the Divergent series.

overview.de: Tris Prior (Shailene Woodley) musste mit ihrem Freund Four (Theo James) und weiteren Verbündeten bei den friedfertigen Amite untertauchen. Doch als "Unbestimmte" werden sie weiterhin von der machthungrigen Ken-Anführerin Jeanine (Kate Winslet) gejagt. Tris und Four suchen in den verschiedenen Fraktionen verzweifelt nach Unterstützung im Kampf gegen Jeanine. Zugleich müssen sie herausfinden, welches Geheimnis von Tris' Eltern sogar bis über deren Tod hinaus gehütet wird.
overview.en: Beatrice 'Tris' Prior must confront her inner demons and continue her fight against a powerful alliance which threatens to tear her society apart with the help of others on her side.
Freed after 20 years, a Cuban plantation owner joins a boat migration to Miami and finds unexpected love and heartbreak on the way back to his family.
A scientist arrives at the small alpine village of Trollenberg to investigate the decapitation of a mountaineer. His death, he suspects, has links to other gruesome murders in South America.

overview.de: Bissige und vergnügliche schwarze Komödie über ein Abendessen unter Freunden, das komplett aus den Fugen gerät. Diese brillante Hommage an Hitchcocks „Immer Ärger mit Harry“ sprüht vor Wortwitz, Situationskomik und ist ein absoluter Hochgenuss. Das gutsituierte Londoner Ehepaar Sarah (Shirley Henderson, „Harry Potter“) und Tom (Alan Tudyk, „Firefly“) lädt ihre engsten Freunde Richard (Rufus Sewell, „Old“) und Beth (Olivia Williams, „The Crown“) zu einer Dinnerparty ein. Diese ahnen nicht, dass es sich um ein Abschiedsessen handelt, denn die stilvolle Villa muss eilig verkauft werden, um den Bankrott der Familie zu verhindern. Voller Vorfreude auf Toms Kochkünste bringen sie auch ihre alte, gemeinsame Freundin Jessica (Indira Varma) mit. Nach einem scheinbar trivialen Streit nimmt sich die berühmte Autorin völlig unerwartet das Leben. Ein Riesenschlamassel, denn mit einer Leiche im Garten droht der Verkauf der Villa an den schwerreichen, deutschen Investor (Sylvester Groth) zu scheitern. Die einzige Lösung: Die Leiche muss weg! Was kann da schon schiefgehen? „Drei Gänge und ein Todessfall“ ist ein vergnügter Filmgenuss mit Tiefgang, der sich mit enttäuschten Lebensträumen, wahrer Freundschaft, Eitelkeiten, Lebenslügen und der Frage auseinandersetzt, wie man sich in einer Millionenstadt unbemerkt einer Leiche entledigt.

3 Caminos tells the life story of five friends, each one of a different nationality, all of them conected by El Camino in three specific moments of their lives. Along this path we enter in their lives: the passage of time, their dreams, the stories of couples and friendships, and how this will transform their personalities.
Young love is tough, especially when the teens have a zombie virus and are trying to outrun the feds on what turns out to be a hilarious road trip.
Un sargento estadounidense se encuentra en Berlín, donde el deber militar se combina con un trauma de posguerra y un romance inesperado.

After a deadly shooting, a police officer wakes up decades in the future. In a world where a TV show organises bloody combats between warriors from different eras, Ryan must fight the best of them to survive.
In this fact-based music comedy, a crew of salty fishermen in the Celtic nation of Cornwall get signed to Universal Records and hit the Top 10 charts.
The crew of an alien spaceship confronts an evil galactic ruler, who aims to take over the universe, and lands on Earth, for sexy adventures in love.
