title.en: The Great Escape II: The Untold Story

overview.en: A former prisoner of war leads a special task force to hunt down the culprits who carried out the orders to murder 50 escapees from Stalag Luft III.
A young man’s grandfather begins grooming him to be the successor to his murderous satanic cult that sacrifices its victims on Halloween.

This season on Influenced, top content creators Achieng Agutu, Eyal Booker, Tefi Pessoa, Taryn Delanie Smith, and Cyrus Veyssi dive into some of the buzziest topics on social media. They’ll try out some of the hottest trends, share their best life hacks, and talk to some of your favorite celebrities.

Set in the fictional present and starring Anthony Hopkins, the 80 year-old King Lear divides his kingdom among his daughters, Goneril, Regan and Cordelia, according to their affection for him. When his youngest daughter, Cordelia, refuses to flatter him, hurt and angry Lear banishes her. With that fateful decision, family and state collapse into chaos and warfare.

Narrated by and featuring Woody Harrelson, Kiss the Ground is an inspiring and groundbreaking film that reveals the first viable solution to our climate crisis. Kiss the Ground reveals that, by regenerating the world’s soils, we can completely and rapidly stabilize Earth’s climate, restore lost ecosystems, and create abundant food supplies. Using compelling graphics and visuals, along with striking NASA and NOAA footage, the film artfully illustrates how, by drawing down atmospheric carbon, soil is the missing piece of the climate puzzle. This movie is positioned to catalyze a movement to accomplish the impossible – to solve humanity’s greatest challenge, to balance the climate and secure our species' future.

title.de: Lion Man - Die Todeskralle aus Istanbul

overview.en: This Turkish classic tells of a prince raised among lions. When he grows up, he uses his strength and claw-like hands for revenge.
An ambitious TV network executive tries to produce a controversial reality show, where contestants play Russian roulette, live on television.
When a new Mega Shark menaces mankind, the government unleashes the Mecha Shark to defeat the monster in a pitched battle that threatens the planet.
The catastrophic destruction that follows a massive meteor’s crash into Earth sends a rancher and a little girl on the run from brutal mercenaries.
Earth's gravity pulls the moon into the path of the planet. A group of scientists must stop the moon from hitting the Earth before it's too late.
A scientist races against the clock in an attempt to save Earth from a series of deadly meteor attacks.

title.de: Neo Nuggets - Eine Pulled Pork Komödie
title.en: Neo Nuggets: A Pulled Pork Comedy

overview.de: Flo Kienzl (Paul Pizzera) und Eddi Kovac (Otto Jaus) wollten eigentlich ein ruhiges Leben führen - doch als Samira (Gizem Emre) plötzlich wieder auftaucht, inklusive einer Truppe schwerbewaffneter Gestalten und einem mysteriösen Schatz im Toplitzsee, bleibt den beiden keine Wahl als ihrer totgeglaubten Schwester zu helfen.
overview.en: Flo Kienzl and Eddi Kovac wanted to lead a quiet life-but when Samira suddenly reappears, accompanied by a group of heavily armed figures and a mysterious treasure in Lake Toplitz, the two have no choice but to help their sister, whom they believed to be dead.
A mysterious woman on the run, and the resourceful fixer assigned to bring her in. Their two unique stories inextricably link, as the stakes of the pursuit rise to apocalyptic proportions.
When an alien spacecraft is being sought by various factions on Earth, a cyborg and rogue trader team up to stop them from taking over the ship.

After going "overboard" on his yacht, a spoiled, rich playboy (Eugenio Derbez) with amnesia is convinced by a single mother (Ana Faris) that he is her husband and is set to work for the first time in his life! But can a lie keep a new love together?
HD. To avenge the murders of his wife and daughter, a lawyer takes a vow of silence and transforms himself into a lean, mean fighting machine.

overview.de: Zwei Zauberkünstler beginnen einen Wettstreit darüber, wer als erster die ultimative Bühnenillusion erschaffen kann.
overview.en: Rival stage magicians in London at the end of the 19th century engage in competitive one-upmanship, with tragic consequences.
A U.S. Army Lt. and his platoon must hold a vital road down against relentless German attacks at the start of WWII’s “Battle of the Bulge.”
A young Polish woman’s love for her Ukrainian boyfriend is disrupted by a forced marriage to a rich widower and the horrors to come of World War II.
John Travolta stars as a speedboat racing champion and multimillionaire whose secret life as a drug trafficker lands him in a deadly crossfire between the DEA and the Mob.
Viajeros descubren que sus vacaciones se convierten en pesadillas cuando una infestación de arañas mortales se escapa en pleno vuelo.
An art designer for a videogame is forced to confront her childhood traumas when colleagues ask her to gather visual materials from an old mansion she inherited from her estranged father.
Five years after their son’s death, a family is swept into a dark mystery when his old girlfriend appears to tell them she’s pregnant with his baby.

overview.de: Patrick Wilson fährt als Limo-Chauffeur direkt in die Hölle: chaotisch-actionreicher Trip in die nächtliche Halbwelt von L.A. -6000 Dollar Spielschulden und nur 24 Stunden Zeit: Der abgewrackte Limo-Fahrer Stretch (Patrick Wilson) hat ein dickes Problem. Das könnte der exzentrische Millionär Laurent (James Badge Dale) lösen, der Stretch engagiert. Aber Laurent mit seinen seltsamen Sonderwünschen ist nur eine der schrägen Figuren, denen Stretch in einer unglaublichen Nacht begegnen wird.
overview.en: The director of Smokin' Aces brings you this action-comedy where a limo driver with a dark past takes on an eccentric billionaire client in hopes of a big payday.

Created by and starring former British Royal Marines Commandos. Forced to confront the death of his daughter following a fatal encounter with drugs, ex-military soldier Andy becomes hell-bent on finding those responsible. With nothing to lose, a violent criminal underworld unravels in his wake.

overview.de: Ein unerklärliches Phänomen löscht die gesamte Erdbevölkerung aus, nur ein Außenposten in Russland bleibt von der Apokalypse verschont. Im Laufe ihrer Außenmissionen werden die Soldaten von einer unbekannten Streitmacht angegriffen. Auf der Suche nach Antworten machen die Überlebenden eine grausame Entdeckung, die den Fortbestand der Menschheit infrage stellen wird …
overview.en: When an unexplained phenomenon wipes out most life on Earth, a military crew finds an outpost of survivors in a small section of Eastern Europe.

Four friends break into an abandoned insane asylum in search of a death certificate which will grant one of them a large inheritance. However, finding it soon becomes the least of their worries in a place haunted by dark memories.

overview.de: Als moderner Wissenschaftler kämpft Tommy mit der Sterblichkeit und sucht verzweifelt nach dem medizinischen Durchbruch, der das Leben seiner krebskranken Frau Izzi retten könnte.
overview.en: Spanning over one thousand years, and three parallel stories, The Fountain is a story of love, death, spirituality, and the fragility of our existence in this world.

title.de: The Uninvited - Der Tod ist immer bei dir

overview.en: In this supernatural horror film, an interior designer's wedding plans are upended by a mysterious, alluring woman with sinister powers. Jung-won is getting ready for his big day when he encounters Yun, a woman who can see spirits from the afterlife. Soon, Yun draws him into an intimate, haunting world of terrifying danger.

title.de: Tulsa - Ein Mädchen gibt nicht auf

overview.en: A desperate Marine biker finds his life turned upside-down, when he is suddenly united with the sassy 9-year-old daughter he never knew existed.
Two college students and best girlfriends get caught cheating on an exam, so their professor takes his revenge on them in the worst possible way.
In the late '60s, fashion designer Ana enlists friends Clara, Pedro and Raúl to open a store and design school in Barcelona in this "Velvet" spinoff.
Una empresaria arriesga sus aspiraciones políticas y su vida para encontrar al responsable de la muerte de su marido en un accidente de barco.

Set in the late 1800s, this origin story follows Abby Walker, an affluent Bostonian whose husband is murdered before her eyes while on their journey out West, as she crosses paths with Hoyt Rawlins, a lovable rogue in search of purpose. Abby and Hoyt's journey takes them to Independence, Texas, a small town with a big future.

overview.de: Ein ehrgeiziger junger DJ hat die Menge fest im Griff, doch dann setzt er für seine aufkeimende Beziehung mit der Freundin seines Mentors alles aufs Spiel.
overview.en: We Are Your Friends is about what it takes to find your voice. Set in the world of electronic music and Hollywood nightlife, an aspiring 23-year-old DJ named Cole (Zac Efron) spends his days scheming with his childhood friends and his nights working on the one track that will set the world on fire.

overview.de: Für die junge Mia Hall ändert sich das Leben im Handumdrehen, nachdem sie bei einem Autounfall ins Koma gefallen ist. Während einer außerkörperlichen Erfahrung muss sie sich entscheiden, ob sie aufwacht und ein anderes Leben führt, als sie es sich vorgestellt hat. Die Wahl liegt bei ihr, ob sie weitermachen kann.
overview.en: After a car wreck leaves her suspended between life and death, a teenager faces a choice that will determine her ultimate fate.

When Tricia finds out that her uncle has gone missing while ghost hunting in Death Valley, she takes her boyfriend on a road trip to try and locate him. When they find him, in a small deserted town, they discover that not only are ghosts real, but more dangerous than they could ever have imagined. Lost Lake is a terrifying horror film with a twist ending that will leave you breathless.

overview.de: Robert Pattinson geht in dieser Sci-Fi-Satire als Freiwilliger auf tödliche Missionen - und wird nach seinem Ableben neu geklont. Bis er plötzlich doppelt existiert. Vom "Parasite"-Regisseur.
overview.en: From the Academy Award-winning writer/director of "Parasite," Bong Joon Ho, comes his next groundbreaking cinematic experience, Mickey 17. The unlikely hero, Mickey Barnes (Robert Pattinson) has found himself in the extraordinary circumstance of working for an employer who demands the ultimate commitment to the job... to die, for a living.
A group of aspiring actors and writers in Hollywood make ends meet by working for a Los Angeles catering company. The crew learn a lot from the different events they are sent to each week.

overview.de: Um den Schulwechsel von dem Asperger-Autisten Jason auf eine Förderschule zu umgehen, schließen Vater und Sohn einen Pakt: Der Junge verspricht, sich nicht mehr von anderen ärgern zu lassen, wenn Mirco ihm hilft seinen Lieblings-Fußballverein zu finden. Die Kriterien sind jedoch sehr spezifisch und er möchte die Vereine live sehen, was die beiden auf eine gemeinsame Reise durch Deutschland führt.
overview.en: Un joven desubicado quien apuesta y bebe, acepta ser el entrenador de un equipo de las pequeñas ligas de Cambrini Green en Chicago como condición de un préstamo que le hizo un amigo.

overview.de: In seinem unverwechselbaren, lockeren Stil erzählt Sam Morril in diesem pointenreichen Comedy-Special mühelos von der schlimmsten Person, die er je gedatet hat, von den Komplikationen des Älterwerdens und von seiner Sicht auf gesellschaftliche Themen.
overview.en: In his distinct laid-back style, Sam Morril effortlessly riffs on the worst person he’s ever dated, the complications of getting older, and his perspective on societal issues in this punchline-heavy comedy special.
